text:
maria: Kicking off quokka-6B onboarding intake. Goal: validate quality vs raven-13b and plan a safe cross-environment rollout (hosted/dedicated/private). Short checklist below, please react with :eyes: and add blockers.

devon: Nice. Quick summary of what we learned in perf runs — int8 quant looks promising for latency/cost, int4 degrades summaries on our long-doc tests.

ashok: Can we get the eval matrix in one place? I ran summarization, long-context QA, and instruction-following tests. Posting top-level numbers:
- Summarization ROUGE-L: quokka-6B (FP16)=0.72, raven-13b (FP16)=0.74
- Summarization ROUGE-L: quokka-6B (int8)=0.71
- Long-context QA EM: quokka-6B (FP16)=0.66, int8=0.65
- Generation p95 latency (hosted, 16k ctx): FP16=310ms, int8=220ms

sree: Noted the small quality delta vs raven. What are our acceptance thresholds for canary? We usually require <=2% relative drop on core metrics and p95 latency improvement if we claim perf win.

maria: Proposal for canary acceptance:
- Relative ROUGE/EM drop <= 0.02 (2% absolute relative), with manual inspection of failing prompts
- No new hallucination classes in the hallucination checks (sample size 200)
- p95 latency improvement >= 15% for int8 path on hosted
- Cost per 1k tokens reduced by >= 18% for int8 compared to raven

eva: Ops/infra notes: For dedicated/private customers we must ship both FP16 and int8 artifacts. Private deployments require k8s manifests to support fallback; I'll draft the manifest snippet.

oliver: For rollout plan I suggest multi-stage canary across modes:
1) Internal smoke (ci) — synthetic traffic, 1h
2) Hosted canary — 1% traffic (24h), monitor errors/latency/quality tests on sampling
3) Hosted ramp — 5% (48h), 20% (24h), then cutover if ok
4) Dedicated pilot — 1 customer pool (manual), 72h
5) Private customers — coordinate with SEs, staged upgrades with preflight checks

maria: Fallback policy: route to raven-13b FP16 when:
- model returns non-JSON when JSON expected AND retry fails
- token-level error rate > 0.5% for 5m window
- quality regression alert fires for a specific prompt set (auto rollback)

devon: Can we have automated checks that sample 500 completions per hour from the canary traffic and run the eval harness? If regressions show, auto scale-down the canary to 0% and notify SRE + ML oncall.

ashok: Added a simple deploy config snippet for canary percentages and auto-fallback (for deploy-bot):
```
canary:
  mode: weighted
  initial: 0.01  # 1%
  steps: [0.05, 0.2]
  watch_metrics:
    - name: rouge_l
      threshold: -0.02
    - name: p95_latency_ms
      threshold: -0.15
fallback:
  target_model: raven-13b
  trigger_conditions:
    - error_rate > 0.005
    - eval_regression == true
```

sree: Two operational items: (1) make sure KV/prefix caching compatibility is validated (some of quokka's attention tweaks change cache shapes), (2) confirm tokenizer parity with raven to avoid tokenization drift.

maria: Agreed. Who owns the preflight checklist items? I'll take manual eval + hallucination set. @devon please own the canary automation and sampling hooks. @eva handle manifests and private deployment docs. @ashok run the quantization sweep logs and post artifacts.

devon: On it. I'll wire up the sampling to the eval harness and create an incident playbook for rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: quokka-6B int8 artifact -> staging; expected start 2026-04-02T09:00Z. CI smoke tests pending.

maria: Final quick wins to close before staging canary:
- [ ] confirm tokenizer parity
- [ ] KV cache shape smoke tests
- [ ] automated sampling pipeline hooked to eval harness
- [ ] deploy manifest with fallback route
- [ ] doc the rollback playbook + SLAs

ashok: I'll upload quant logs + accuracy_vs_tokens CSV to the onboarding folder after the sweep completes (~2h).

oliver: If hosted canary passes we should prepare a note for product/CS about differences vs raven: slightly lower ROUGE on long summaries but 30% cost win on int8 and 20% latency p95 win.

maria: Perfect. We'll sync tomorrow 10am PT to review canary health. Thanks all :thumbsup:
